product.title: Private Angels Landing Hike Permit Included

description.text: Summit Angels Landing on a private guided hike with your permit secured and chain-section pacing handled by a certified leader. The route climbs Walter's Wiggles switchbacks to Scout Lookout, then continues along the exposed ridge with safety briefings at each chain segment before reaching the iconic canyon viewpoint. Private format limits the outing to your party for focused pacing, hydration checks, and flexible turnaround decisions. Suitable for fit hikers comfortable with heights who want permit logistics and expert guidance on Zion's most famous trail.

highlights: Private Angels Landing hike with permit included
Scout Lookout rest before the exposed ridge
Flexible private party format for one to four hikers

start.description: Meet at the Zion Canyon Visitor Center, Springdale, UT 84767. Start early for parking and permit check-in.

end.description: Descend to the Grotto trailhead after the summit or Scout Lookout turnaround.

faqs.question: How long is the Private Angels Landing Hike Permit Included?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 4 to 6 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from at Zion National Park?
faqs.answer: Meet at the Zion Canyon Visitor Center, Springdale, UT 84767. Start early for parking and permit check-in.

faqs.question: Is the Angels Landing permit included in the price?
